punchline: According to Adam Grant, the most successful salespeople were often the ones who could say to a customer, "You do not need this."
thirty_sec: Adam Grant explains that those most successful in sales are often the most generous, the givers. These salespeople recommended not the most expensive product but the one that suited the customer, and said "you do not need this" when it was true. Even if they lost the first sale, customers came back and sent others. Trust returned more than a one-off gain.
